binder_diff_method: kb/0227: a /tmp file importing the built module defines `#binders` (forallTelescope on each constant's type: binder info, user name, ppExpr type, and the body). The 11 pairs were diffed with difflib.SequenceMatcher on the (binderinfo, name, type) lists, with format.width 100000 and pp.fullNames. The universe parameters were compared as well. A second /tmp probe proves each of the 10 trade forms from its _noArc form by `intros; apply <noArc form> <;> assumption`. It also proves Step 1 from hG.1 and hC₁ with the instances, and checks that hlocal gives LocalUniqueness (D := V, Sp := S). Scratch files: /tmp/noarc/Binders.lean, diff.py, Stronger.lean, Route.lean (outside the repository).
findings: No step of Theorem 4.64 (all three forms), Remark 4.67's first sentence, Corollary 4.68 (both forms), 4.69, 4.71, 4.73 or the m-GHD's uniqueness needs the acausality of S, on a T2, second countable background with S Cauchy in U₁. Re-reading ers_theorem_4_64_maxCommonDevelopment (Causal/ErsUniqueness.lean:433–464) confirms this for U₁ ∩ U₂. hacausal enters only through isCommonDevelopment_maxCommonDevelopment (Step 1, called at :445, defined at :361, where two points of S on one inextensible curve of V₀ must coincide). The _of_localUniqueness_ form also uses it through ers_prop_4_63's union (isCauchySurfaceOn_sSup_of_isAcausalOn), and 4.68/4.69/4.71/4.73 only by calling 4.64. hsplit enters at V₀ ∩ U₁ ∩ U₂ ≠ ∅ (:450–452) and at exists_isSpacelikeBoundaryPoint (:457). Step 1 holds with S Cauchy in U₁ in place of S acausal in U₁ (isCauchySurfaceOn_sSup_of_secondCountable, ambient U₁), Prop 4.63's union is Causal.Ers475CauchyForm's, and SplitBy is splitBy_of_t1_secondCountable. So harc leaves every one of these forms. This is a finding about the library's trade forms, which over-assume, and not about the paper: ERS's Step 1 (ghd_02_19.tex:868, 'It is immediate') uses no acausality either.

Where the acausality (so harc) is still needed is located, out of scope, and was not attempted. (a) Remark 4.67's second and third sentences, at Jplus_inter_subset_of_isCauchySurfaceOn_of_t1_secondCountable (Causal/Ers464SecondCountable.lean:391, the step hσσ' : σ = σ' from σ ≤_{U₁} x ≤_{U₁} σ' at :401) and its past form. Whether those sentences fail without harc is not settled here: no counterexample was tried. (b) The GH forms (V₀ or U₁ ∩ U₂ globally hyperbolic, causally convex in U₁, through causallyConvexIn_of_isCauchySurfaceOn, Causal/CBG/CausalConvex.lean:212, which takes CausallyArcConnectedOn). (c) Theorems 4.79/4.80, where harc also gives antisymmetry through curve nesting (a different route).

The removal is not vacuous. densCausality (Causal.CBG.SubExtensionAbstract, a non-local causality of ℝ) is not causally arc-connected on ℝ, yet every hypothesis of the _noArc forms holds on the standard data (U₁ = ℝ, U₂ = ]-1, 1[, S = {0}, the clamp). There the trade forms do not apply and the _noArc forms do (densCausality_ers_theorem_4_64_of_isCauchySurfaceOn_secondCountable_noArc). S = {0} is acausal there, so the originals of Causal.ErsUniqueness also apply: the _noArc forms are not shown to reach beyond the originals.
